subValue.description: Display sub value for the cell.

dropdownOptions.description:
Option values for the dropdown cell.
Should not be defined if isDropdown is false.

isDropdown.description: Whether or not this cell should render as a dropdown.

icon.description: Field with the icon name to be rendered. This should be the icon suffix, e.g. for c3-icon-caret-up -> `caret-up`.

iconColor.description: Color to be used for the icon. Only used if #icon is specified as well.

actionSuffix.description: Optional action suffix for this data point.

color.description:
Populated if this cell has a custom color. Can take {@link ThemedColor},
simple colors in strings or even raw CSS expressions as strings. For example, 'var(--token)'

isHighlighted.description:
Whether the current data point is highlighted.
For example, UI could do special treatment based on this info.

isEditable.description:
Whether the current data point is editable.
Header cells are not editable even if this field is set to true.

isSectionEnd.description:
Whether the current data point marks the ending of a section
For example, UI could show a thick vertical line after this data point.

format.description:
The configs for how to display the date and numerical values in the grid.
If nothing is provided, it will look at {@link UiCollapsibleGridTreeNode row}
and {@link UiCollapsibleGridTree column} format specs.
To note, date formatting can only be provided at this level.
If a date is provided as a value in milliseconds without specifying a format here,
it will formatted as a number if either of {@link UiCollapsibleGridTreeNode row} or
{@link UiCollapsibleGridTree column} format specs exist.
Therefore, it's recommended to specify dates as either an ISO 8601 string or a localized string.

cellActions.description:
The list of cell-specific actions to be rendered using {@link UiSdlActionGroup}.

This field should be used exclusively from the other fields on {@link UiCollapsibleGridTreeNodeDatum}.
If other fields are specified along with the `cellActions` field, this field will take precedence
and the others will be ignored.

To emit a single action by clicking the blue text in the cell, use #actionSuffix instead.

cellActionsCollapseThreshold.description:
The number of #cellActions to display in a cell. If there are more, an additional ellipsis
action icon is displayed, and the extra cell actions are displayed under a dropdown
triggered by clicking the ellipsis action button.

The additional ellipsis cell action does not count towards the limit. Examples:

  - If `cellActionsCollapseThreshold` is set to 3 and there are two cell actions, both of them are shown
    in the cell, and there is no additional ellipsis action icon.
  - If `cellActionsCollapseThreshold` is set to 2 and there are three actions - "A", "B", and "C" - the
    cell will show action "A" and the additional ellipsis action icon. Clicking the ellipsis action icon
    will show a dropdown menu containing actions "B" and "C".

title: Represents a cell in a row in {@link UiCollapsibleGrid}.
name: UiCollapsibleGridTreeNodeDatum
